description: Information about a genomic annotation / track file. GenomicAnnotationFile is a specification of the File entity and inherits all the fields defined in File, in addition to the fields that are specific to GenomicAnnotationFile, as detailed here. This is the class that composes the five ONGA descriptor schemas: the required reference_genome (the coordinate system) plus the recommended track_format, track_interpretation, track_provenance, and track_geometry descriptors.

access_methods.description: The list of access methods that can be used to fetch the data file.

checksums.description: A list of checksums of the data file. For blobs, the checksum is computed over the bytes in the blob.

created_time.description: Timestamp of content creation in RFC3339. (This is the creation time of the underlying content, not of the JSON object.).

drs_uri.description: A drs:// hostname-based URI, as defined in the DRS documentation, that tells clients how to access this object. The intent of this field is to make DRS objects self-contained, and therefore easier for clients to store and pass around. For example, if you arrive at this DRS JSON by resolving a compact identifier-based DRS URI, the self_uri presents you with a hostname and properly encoded DRS ID for use in subsequent access endpoint calls.

file_description.description: A human readable description of the data file.

file_external_id.description: External, globally unique identifier for the data file.

file_id.description: Internal identifier for the data file (unique within the metadata deposit).

file_input_sources.description: External or internal references to data sources for the file, typically a data collection or a process that has generated the file. Internal references should lead to FileCollection, File, Experiment, or Analysis objects.

file_label.description: A human-readable description of the data file, short enough to be used for listings within software user interfaces, tables, illustration legends, etc.

file_name.description: A string that can be used to name a data file. This string is made up of uppercase and lowercase letters, decimal digits, hypen, period, and underscore [A-Za-z0-9.-_]. See http://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9699919799/basedefs/V1_chap03.html#tag_03_282 [portable filenames].

file_size.description: For blobs, the blob size in bytes.

file_type.description: The file format of the data file, as an ontology term. For genomic annotation files the authoritative format is `TrackFormat.file_format` (the ONGA Format vocabulary, reached via `track_format` on GenomicAnnotationFile); `file_type` exists for non-annotation files (e.g. FASTQ) that File also covers.

file_version.description: A string representing a version. (Some systems may use checksum, a RFC3339 timestamp, or an incrementing version number.).

filecollection_refs.description: Internal references to the FileCollection objects (within the deposit) that contains the data file, if any.

genomic_annotation_digest.description: Content-derived digest for distributed identification of genomic annotation files. (This field is currently a placeholder, as an algorithm for generating such a digest is yet to be specified.).

mime_type.description: A string providing the mime-type of the data file.

quality_assessments.description: An array of QualityAssessment objects containing the main quality scores from assessment techniques applied to the data file.

reference_genome.description: The reference genome the annotation is defined against, consequently defining the genomic coordinate system for the annotation. Renamed from the FGA-WG slot genome_assembly; the range is the ONGA ReferenceGenome descriptor schema. Required: a genomic annotation without a coordinate system is not a genomic annotation.

run_provenance.description: Document detailing the provenance of the experiment or analysis run which produced the file as one of its outputs. The provenance info should include software versions, parameter settings, etc.

track_format.description: How the track is encoded on disk: the TrackFormat descriptor (file_format drawing on the Format vocabulary, plus BED column conventions).

track_geometry.description: Geometric properties of the sequence features in the genomic annotation file if considered as an one-dimensional genome browser track (also relevant for non-visual analyses).

track_interpretation.description: What the track content represents: the TrackInterpretation descriptor (output_type / feature_type drawing on the DataType and FeatureType vocabularies, plus the content facets).

track_provenance.description: What was done to the data: the TrackProvenance descriptor (processing/derivation facets such as read_multiplicity, filter_status, normalization, thresholding, derivation).

updated_time.description: Timestamp of content update in RFC3339, identical to created_time in systems that do not support updates. (This is the update time of the underlying content, not of the JSON object.).

title: GenomicAnnotationFile
